##### Differential Abundance #####
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(microbiome)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
library(DESeq2)

options(scipen = 999)

theme_set(theme_classic())

# color blind pallet used throughout 
cbbPalette <- c("#000000", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7")
ibm.cbb <- c("#648FFF", "#785EF0", "#DC267F", "#FE6100", "grey")
tol.cbb <- c("#332288", "#117733", "#44AA99", "#88CCEE", "#DDCC77", "#CC6677", "#AA4499", "#882255")
extra.cbb <- c("#089", "#890", "#321", "#245", "#789", "#125", "#100", "#900", "#991", "#678912", "#199832", "#981734", "#299999", "#45611234", "#892393", "#183")
```

The strategy for this analysis is to identify those that are possibly seed origin and transmitted to the spermosphere and into the rhizosphere. 

To do this, the strategy is the following: 

Step 1:
Plant-associated trajectory
Planting -> 17hrs -> V2

Find taxa with a significant positive trend
(MaAsLin coefficient > 0)

Step 2:
Soil-only trajectory
Planting -> 17hrs -> V2

Find taxa with a significant positive trend

Step 3:
Remove taxa that also increase in bulk soil

Plant-associated taxa
MINUS
Bulk-soil taxa

Step 4:
Intersect with seed epiphyte taxa

Remaining taxa
INTERSECT
Seed taxa


#### Read in RDS file #### 
```{r}
bac_sperm <- readRDS(
  "2024-01-24_SpermosphereSteaming_Bacteria/RDS/Bacteria_spermosphere_nonnorm_2024-01-24.rds"
)
```

### Set up the analysis for the plant associated habitats
Being very strict on those found on seed surfaces to not get spurious non-associated seed colonists. 
These are microbes found on seed surfaces on all four replicate samples (prevelence = 1), and ranked cumulative RA of 99%. 
Results of 148 taxa. 
```{r}
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(bac_sperm))

top_epi <- bac_sperm %>%
  subset_samples(Trt == "Soybean Epiphytes") %>%
  phyloseq::filter_taxa(function(x) sum(x) > 0, TRUE) %>%
  microbiome::transform("compositional") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  group_by(OTU_Label) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    mean_RA = mean(Abundance),
    prevalence = mean(Abundance > 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_RA)) %>%
  mutate(
    cumulative_RA = cumsum(mean_RA)) %>%
  filter(cumulative_RA <= 0.99 & prevalence == 1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(OTU_Label)

epi_otus <- top_epi

tax_df1 <- data.frame(tax_table(bac_sperm))

bac_sperm %>%
  subset_samples(Trt == "Soybean Epiphytes") %>%
  phyloseq::subset_taxa(OTU_Label %in% top_epi) %>%
  microbiome::transform("compositional") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Order)) +
  geom_col()


### Supplemental table X ####
top_epi_supp <- bac_sperm %>%
```

### Also going to restrict analysis to those found in non-seed epiphyte samples at 5 times in 10% of samples. To eliminate spurious OTUs. 
```{r}
bac_filt <- bac_sperm %>%
  subset_samples(Trt != "Soybean Epiphytes") %>%
  phyloseq::filter_taxa(function(x) sum(x >= 5) >= 0.10 * length(x), TRUE)
```

## function to carry out the differential abudnance tests. 
```{r}
# Function to classify OTUs based on their differential abundance
# trajectories across the seed (Planting), spermosphere (17 hrs),
# and rhizosphere (V2) stages.
classify_deseq_changes <- function(ps,
                                   trt,
                                   types = c("Spermosphere",
                                             "Rhizosphere"),
                                   alpha = 0.05) {

  # Extract sample metadata
  sam <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))

  # Keep only samples from the specified treatment and
  # the three time points used in the trajectory analysis
  keep <- sam$Time %in% c("Planting", "17hrs", "V2") &
    sam$Type %in% types &
    sam$Trt == trt

  # Prune phyloseq object to selected samples
  ps_sub <- prune_samples(keep, ps)

  # Convert phyloseq object to DESeq2 format
  # Time is used as the explanatory variable
  dds <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(ps_sub, ~ Time)

  # Run DESeq2 differential abundance analysis
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  # -------------------------------------------
  # Pairwise comparisons between developmental stages
  # -------------------------------------------

  # Spermosphere (17 hrs) vs spermosphere at planting
  # Positive LFC = enriched in spermosphere 17 hours
  seed_vs_sperm <- results(
    dds,
    contrast = c("Time", "17hrs", "Planting")
  )

  # Rhizosphere (V2) vs Spermosphere (17 hrs)
  # Positive LFC = enriched in rhizosphere 
  sperm_vs_rhizo <- results(
    dds,
    contrast = c("Time", "V2", "17hrs")
  )

  # Rhizosphere (V2) vs spermosphere at planting
  # Positive LFC = enriched in rhizosphere relative to spermosphere planting
  seed_vs_rhizo <- results(
    dds,
    contrast = c("Time", "V2", "Planting")
  )

  # Combine results into a single data frame
  res <- data.frame(
    OTU = rownames(seed_vs_sperm),

    lfc_seed_sperm = seed_vs_sperm$log2FoldChange,
    padj_seed_sperm = seed_vs_sperm$padj,

    lfc_sperm_rhizo = sperm_vs_rhizo$log2FoldChange,
    padj_sperm_rhizo = sperm_vs_rhizo$padj,

    lfc_seed_rhizo = seed_vs_rhizo$log2FoldChange,
    padj_seed_rhizo = seed_vs_rhizo$padj
  ) %>%
    mutate(

      # Classify OTUs according to their abundance trajectory
      Category = case_when(

        # -------------------------------------------
        # Spermosphere specialist
        # Pattern: Spermosphere (planting) < Spermosphere > Rhizosphere
        # OTU peaks in the spermosphere but declines by V2
        # -------------------------------------------
        lfc_seed_sperm > 0 &
          padj_seed_sperm < alpha &
          lfc_sperm_rhizo < 0 &
          padj_sperm_rhizo < alpha
        ~ "Spermosphere specialist",

        # -------------------------------------------
        # Progressive colonizer
        # Pattern: Spermosphere (planting) < Spermosphere < Rhizosphere
        # OTU continually increases through plant development
        # -------------------------------------------
        lfc_seed_sperm > 0 &
          padj_seed_sperm < alpha &
          lfc_sperm_rhizo > 0 &
          padj_sperm_rhizo < alpha
        ~ "Progressive colonizer",

        # -------------------------------------------
        # Progressive decliner
        # Pattern: Spermosphere (planting) > Spermosphere > Rhizosphere
        # OTU continually decreases through development
        # -------------------------------------------
        lfc_seed_sperm < 0 &
          padj_seed_sperm < alpha &
          lfc_sperm_rhizo < 0 &
          padj_sperm_rhizo < alpha
        ~ "Progressive decliner",

        # -------------------------------------------
        # Rhizosphere specialist
        # Pattern: Spermosphere (planting) ≈ Spermosphere < Rhizosphere
        # OTU remains stable initially, then increases at V2
        # -------------------------------------------
        # Rhizosphere specialist
          lfc_sperm_rhizo > 0 &
          padj_sperm_rhizo < alpha &
          (
            is.na(padj_seed_sperm) |
            padj_seed_sperm >= alpha
          )
          ~ "Rhizosphere specialist",

        # -------------------------------------------
        # Anything not fitting the above patterns
        # -------------------------------------------
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )

  # Return OTU classifications and DESeq2 statistics
  return(res)

}
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------
# Plant-associated communities
# (Spermosphere planting -> Spermosphere -> Rhizosphere)
# -------------------------------------------

# Steamed soil treatment
# Identifies OTUs that increase, decrease, or specialize
# across plant-associated habitats under steamed conditions
plant_steamed <- classify_deseq_changes(
  ps = bac_filt,
  trt = "Steamed ",
  types = c("Spermosphere", "Rhizosphere")
)

# Non-steamed soil treatment
# Identifies OTU trajectories across plant-associated habitats
# under ambient soil microbial conditions
plant_nonsteamed <- classify_deseq_changes(
  ps = bac_filt,
  trt = "Non.Steamed",
  types = c("Spermosphere", "Rhizosphere")
)

# -------------------------------------------
# Bulk soil communities
# (Soil at planting -> Bulk Soil at 17 hrs -> Bulk Soil at V2)
# -------------------------------------------

# Steamed bulk soil
# Evaluates which taxa do this in soil without a seed,
# persist, or decline in steamed soil over time
soil_steamed <- classify_deseq_changes(
  ps = bac_filt,
  trt = "Steamed ",
  types = c("Bulk.Soil")
)

# Non-steamed bulk soil
# Evaluates temporal trajectories of soil in non steamed
# in the presence of the native soil microbiome
soil_nonsteamed <- classify_deseq_changes(
  ps = bac_filt,
  trt = "Non.Steamed",
  types = c("Bulk.Soil")
)

```

So now we are background correcting. In other words the OTUs that changed in both the soil without any plant associate need to be screened out. 
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compare plant-associated and bulk-soil OTU trajectories
#
# Goal:
# Identify taxa that exhibit ecologically meaningful patterns
# in plant-associated habitats (spermosphere/rhizosphere)
# but not in bulk soil. These taxa are considered
# plant-associated responders.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# STEAMED TREATMENT
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compare_steamed <- plant_steamed %>%

  # Keep OTU identifier and plant-associated category
  select(OTU, Plant = Category) %>%

  # Add the corresponding bulk soil category
  left_join(
    soil_steamed %>%
      select(OTU, Soil = Category),
    by = "OTU"
  ) %>%

  # Compare classification between habitats
  mutate(
    Interpretation = case_when(

      # OTU exhibits the same trajectory in both habitats
      Plant == Soil ~ "Shared response",

      # OTU shows a meaningful pattern only in the
      # plant-associated habitat
      Soil == "Other" & Plant != "Other" ~
        "Plant-associated",

      # OTU exhibits a trajectory in both habitats,
      # but the trajectory differs
      Plant != Soil & Soil != "Other" ~
        "Different trajectory",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%

  # Conservative approach:
  # retain only OTUs showing a meaningful trajectory
  # in plant-associated habitats but not in bulk soil
  filter(
    Interpretation == "Plant-associated"
  ) %>%

  # Store treatment for plotting
  mutate(Treatment = "Steamed")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# NON-STEAMED TREATMENT
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compare_nonsteamed <- plant_nonsteamed %>%

  # Keep OTU identifier and plant-associated category
  select(OTU, Plant = Category) %>%

  # Add corresponding bulk soil category
  left_join(
    soil_nonsteamed %>%
      select(OTU, Soil = Category),
    by = "OTU"
  ) %>%

  # Compare classifications
  mutate(
    Interpretation = case_when(

      Plant == Soil ~ "Shared response",

      Soil == "Other" & Plant != "Other" ~
        "Plant-associated",

      Plant != Soil & Soil != "Other" ~
        "Different trajectory",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%

  # Conservative approach:
  # retain only plant-associated trajectories
  filter(
    Interpretation == "Plant-associated"
  ) %>%

  # Store treatment
  mutate(Treatment = "Non-Steamed")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract taxonomy table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(bac_sperm))


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine treatments and append taxonomy
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plotdat <- rbind(
  compare_nonsteamed,
  compare_steamed
) %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "OTU")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Identify the 20 most common orders among
# plant-associated responders
# ------------------------------------------------------------

top_classes <- plotdat %>%
  dplyr::count(Order) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 15) %>%
  pull(Order)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Collapse infrequent orders into "Other"
# and combine unknown classifications
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plotdat <- plotdat %>%
  mutate(
    Order2 = ifelse(
      Order %in% top_classes,
      Order,
      "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Order2 = case_when(
      Order2 %in% c(
        "uncultured",
        "uncultured_bacterium",
        "unidentified"
      ) ~ "Unknown / uncultured",

      TRUE ~ Order2
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Additional colorblind-friendly palette
# ------------------------------------------------------------

tol20 <- c(
  "#332288", "#88CCEE", "#44AA99", "#117733", "#999933",
  "#DDCC77", "#CC6677", "#882255", "#AA4499", "#661100",
  "#6699CC", "#888888", "#AA4466", "#4477AA", "#228833",
  "#CCBB44", "#EE6677", "#BBBBBB", "#77AADD", "#EE8866"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot taxonomic composition of OTUs exhibiting
# plant-associated trajectories
#
# Facets = trajectory class
# Bars   = treatment
# Colors = bacterial order
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plotdat <- plotdat %>%
  mutate(
    Plant = recode(
      Plant,
      "Progressive colonizer" = "PC",
      "Rhizosphere specialist" = "RS",
      "Spermosphere specialist" = "SS"
    )
  )

diff.abundant.cat <- ggplot(
  plotdat,
  aes(
    x = Treatment,
    fill = Order2
  )
) +
  geom_bar() +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ Plant,
    nrow = 1
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(cbbPalette, tol20),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  xlab("") +
  ylab("Number of OTUs") +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),

    # Match panel b
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 12,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 9
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11)
  )

```

### Ok so now lets plot the tragjectories of individual OTUs. 
```{r}
# ============================================================
# EXTRACT OTUs OF INTEREST FROM THE PLANT-ASSOCIATED ANALYSIS
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Progressive colonizers
#
# Pattern:
# Seed < Spermosphere < Rhizosphere
#
# These OTUs increase continuously throughout plant
# establishment and may represent successful colonists
# of the developing root environment.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Progressive colonizers in non-steamed soil
sperm_otus_nonsteamed <- plotdat %>%
  filter(
    Plant == "Progressive colonizer" &
      Treatment == "Non-Steamed"
  ) %>%
  pull(OTU)

# Progressive colonizers in steamed soil
sperm_otus_steamed <- plotdat %>%
  filter(
    Plant == "Progressive colonizer" &
      Treatment == "Steamed"
  ) %>%
  pull(OTU)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract CLR-transformed abundance data for progressive
# colonizers from plant-associated habitats
#
# Bulk-soil samples are excluded because the objective
# is to visualize trajectories within the
# spermosphere-rhizosphere continuum.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bac_clr_nonsteamed_colonizer <- bac_sperm %>%
  microbiome::transform(transform = "clr") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  subset(
    Trt == "Non.Steamed" &
      Type != "Bulk.Soil" &
      OTU %in% sperm_otus_nonsteamed
  ) %>%
  select(
    Trt,
    Type,
    Time,
    Abundance,
    OTU,
    Phylum:OTU_Label
  )

bac_clr_steamed_colonizer <- bac_sperm %>%
  microbiome::transform(transform = "clr") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  subset(
    Trt == "Steamed " &
      Type != "Bulk.Soil" &
      OTU %in% sperm_otus_steamed
  ) %>%
  select(
    Trt,
    Type,
    Time,
    Abundance,
    OTU,
    Phylum:OTU_Label
  )


# ============================================================
# EXTRACT SPERMOSPHERE SPECIALISTS
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Spermosphere specialists
#
# Pattern:
# Seed < Spermosphere > Rhizosphere
#
# These OTUs are enriched shortly after planting but
# decline as the rhizosphere develops.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Non-steamed treatment
sperm_otus_nonsteamed <- plotdat %>%
  filter(
    Plant == "Spermosphere specialist" &
      Treatment == "Non-Steamed"
  ) %>%
  pull(OTU)

# Steamed treatment
sperm_otus_steamed <- plotdat %>%
  filter(
    Plant == "Spermosphere specialist" &
      Treatment == "Steamed"
  ) %>%
  pull(OTU)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract CLR-transformed abundances for spermosphere
# specialists from plant-associated habitats.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bac_clr_nonsteamed <- bac_sperm %>%
  microbiome::transform(transform = "clr") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  subset(
    Trt == "Non.Steamed" &
      Type != "Bulk.Soil" &
      OTU %in% sperm_otus_nonsteamed
  ) %>%
  select(
    Trt,
    Type,
    Time,
    Abundance,
    OTU,
    Phylum:OTU_Label
  )

bac_clr_steamed <- bac_sperm %>%
  microbiome::transform(transform = "clr") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  subset(
    Trt == "Steamed " &
      Type != "Bulk.Soil" &
      OTU %in% sperm_otus_steamed
  ) %>%
  select(
    Trt,
    Type,
    Time,
    Abundance,
    OTU,
    Phylum:OTU_Label
  )


# ============================================================
# COMBINE THE TWO ECOLOGICAL CATEGORIES
# ============================================================

# Add category labels so both groups can be plotted together

plotdata1 <- rbind.data.frame(
  bac_clr_nonsteamed,
  bac_clr_steamed
) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = "Spermosphere specialist"
  )

plotdata2 <- rbind.data.frame(
  bac_clr_nonsteamed_colonizer,
  bac_clr_steamed_colonizer
) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = "Progressive colonizer"
  )

# Single dataset for plotting
plotdata <- rbind.data.frame(
  plotdata1,
  plotdata2
)


# ============================================================
# SUMMARIZE CLR ABUNDANCE TRAJECTORIES
# ============================================================

plotdat_sum <- plotdata %>%

  # Ensure chronological ordering of developmental stages
  mutate(
    Time = factor(
      Time,
      levels = c(
        "Planting",
        "17hrs",
        "V2"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%

  # Calculate mean trajectory for each OTU
  group_by(
    Category,
    Trt,
    Time,
    OTU,
    OTU_Label,
    Genus
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    mean_CLR = mean(Abundance),
    se_CLR = sd(Abundance) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%

  ungroup() %>%

  # Combine poorly resolved taxa
  mutate(
  Genus2 = case_when(

    Genus %in% c(
      "Allorhizobium-Neorhizobium-Pararhizobium-Rhizobium"
    ) ~ "Rhizobium complex",

    Genus %in% c(
      "uncultured",
      "uncultured_bacterium",
      "unidentified"
    ) ~ "Unknown / uncultured",

    TRUE ~ Genus
  )
) %>%

  # Flag taxa that were identified among
  # the core seed epiphyte community
  mutate(
    Epiphyte = ifelse(
      OTU_Label %in% epi_otus,
      "Yes",
      "No"
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# VISUALIZE SUCCESSION OF PLANT-ASSOCIATED TAXA
# ============================================================

# Each line represents a single OTU.
#
# Color = Genus
# Shape = Whether the OTU was identified as a seed epiphyte
# Facets = Ecological category × treatment
#
# This allows visual assessment of how core seed-associated
# taxa behave through plant establishment under steamed and
# non-steamed conditions.

plotdat_sum <- plotdat_sum %>%
  mutate(
    Category = recode(
      Category,
      "Progressive colonizer" = "PC",
      "Rhizosphere specialist" = "RS",
      "Spermosphere specialist" = "SS"
    )
  )

final.plot <- ggplot(
  plotdat_sum,
  aes(
    x = Time,
    y = mean_CLR,
    group = OTU_Label,
    color = Genus2,
    shape = Epiphyte
  )
) +

  # Individual OTU trajectories
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point() +

  # Separate panels by ecological category and treatment
  facet_grid(Category ~ Trt, scales = "fixed") +

  theme_bw() +

  ylab("CLR abundance") +
  xlab("") +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      cbbPalette,
      ibm.cbb,
      tol.cbb
    )
  ) +

  # Replace abbreviated stage names with descriptive labels
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      Planting = "Spermosphere\nPlanting",
      `17hrs` = "Spermosphere\n17 hrs",
      V2 = "Rhizosphere\nV2"
    )
  ) +

  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    # remove title completely
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    )
  )
```



Lets have some percentages to accompany the words in the manuscript. 
```{r}
# ============================================================
# SUMMARIZE THE NUMBER AND PERCENTAGE OF OTUs IN EACH
# PLANT-ASSOCIATED TRAJECTORY CATEGORY
# ============================================================

category_pct <- plotdat %>%

  # Count OTUs within each treatment × category combination
  dplyr::count(Treatment, Plant) %>%

  # Calculate percentages within each treatment
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = 100 * n / sum(n)
  )

# Total number of classified OTUs
sum(category_pct$n)


# ============================================================
# IDENTIFY GENERA THAT DIFFER BETWEEN STEAMED AND
# NON-STEAMED SOILS FOR RHIZOSPHERE SPECIALISTS
# ============================================================

plotdat %>%

  # Count OTUs by Order, treatment, and category
  dplyr::count(Genus, Treatment, Plant) %>%

  # Calculate relative abundance of each genus
  mutate(
    Percent = round(
      100 * n / sum(n),
      1
    )
  ) %>%

  # Focus only on rhizosphere specialists
  filter(
    Plant == "Rhizosphere specialist"
  ) %>%

  # Retain relevant columns
  select(
    Genus,
    Treatment,
    n
  ) %>%

  # Convert treatments into columns
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Treatment,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%

  # Calculate change in OTU counts under steaming
  mutate(
    Difference = Steamed - `Non-Steamed`
  ) %>%

  # Largest treatment effects first
  arrange(
    desc(abs(Difference))
  ) %>%
  print(n = 45)


# ============================================================
# IDENTIFY GENERA THAT DIFFER BETWEEN STEAMED AND
# NON-STEAMED SOILS FOR SPERMOSPHERE SPECIALISTS
# ============================================================

plotdat %>%

  # Count OTUs by Order, treatment, and category
  dplyr::count(OTU, Treatment, Plant) %>%

  # Focus only on rhizosphere specialists
  filter(
    Plant == "Spermosphere specialist"
  ) %>%

  # Retain relevant columns
  select(
    OTU,
    Treatment,

  # Convert treatments into columns
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Treatment,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%

  # Calculate change in OTU counts under steaming
  mutate(
    Difference = Steamed - `Non-Steamed`
  ) %>%

  # Largest treatment effects first
  arrange(
    desc(abs(Difference))
  ) %>%
  print(n = 45)


# ============================================================
# IDENTIFY GENERA THAT DIFFER BETWEEN STEAMED AND
# NON-STEAMED SOILS FOR PROGRESSIVE COLONIZERS
# ============================================================

plotdat %>%

  # Count OTUs by Order, treatment, and category
  dplyr::count(OTU_Label, Treatment, Plant) %>%

  # Focus only on rhizosphere specialists
  filter(
    Plant == "Progressive colonizer"
  ) %>%

  # Retain relevant columns
  select(
    OTU_Label,
    Treatment,
    n
  ) %>%

  # Convert treatments into columns
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Treatment,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%

  # Calculate change in OTU counts under steaming
  mutate(
    Difference = Steamed - `Non-Steamed`
  ) %>%

  # Largest treatment effects first
  arrange(
    desc(abs(Difference))
  ) %>%
  print(n = 45)

# ============================================================
# IDENTIFY OTUs THAT CHANGE CATEGORY BETWEEN
# NON-STEAMED AND STEAMED CONDITIONS
# ============================================================

transitions <- plotdat %>%

  # Keep OTU identity and category assignments
  select(
    OTU,
    OTU_Label,
    Treatment,
    Plant
  ) %>%

  # Create one column for each treatment
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Treatment,
    values_from = Plant,
    values_fill = "Not classified"
  ) %>%

  # Determine whether category assignment changed
  mutate(
    Changed = ifelse(
      `Non-Steamed` != Steamed,
      "Yes",
      "No"
    )
  ) %>%

  # Keep only OTUs whose classification changed
  filter(
    Changed == "Yes"
  ) %>%

  print(n = 140)


# ============================================================
# CREATE AN ORDERED RANKING OF ECOLOGICAL CATEGORIES
#
# Higher scores correspond to earlier or stronger
# enrichment in the spermosphere.
# ============================================================

transition_rank <- c(
  "Not classified" = 0,
  "Rhizosphere specialist" = 1,
  "Progressive colonizer" = 2,
  "Spermosphere specialist" = 3
)


# ============================================================
# QUANTIFY DIRECTION OF CATEGORY SHIFTS
#
# Positive shift:
#   OTU moved toward an earlier or stronger
#   plant-associated response under steaming.
#
# Negative shift:
#   OTU moved toward a later response or lost its
#   plant-associated classification.
# ============================================================

switchers <- transitions %>%
  mutate(

    # Numerical score in non-steamed soil
    non_score = transition_rank[`Non-Steamed`],

    # Numerical score in steamed soil
    steam_score = transition_rank[Steamed],

    # Direction and magnitude of change
    shift = steam_score - non_score
  )


# ============================================================
# IDENTIFY OTUs THAT SHIFTED TOWARD EARLIER
# PLANT COLONIZATION AFTER STEAMING
#
# Examples:
# Rhizosphere specialist -> Progressive colonizer
# Progressive colonizer -> Spermosphere specialist
# Not classified -> Rhizosphere specialist
# ================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Add taxonomy to transition table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bacilli_switchers <- transitions %>%
  left_join(
    tax_df %>%
      select(OTU, Class, Genus),
    by = "OTU"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Class == "Bacilli",
    Changed == "Yes"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Count transitions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

trans_counts <- bacilli_switchers %>%
  dplyr::count(`Non-Steamed`, Steamed)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Biological ordering
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat_order <- c(
  "Not classified",
  "Rhizosphere specialist",
  "Progressive colonizer",
  "Spermosphere specialist"
)

trans_counts <- trans_counts %>%
  mutate(
    `Non-Steamed` = factor(
      `Non-Steamed`,
      levels = cat_order
    ),
    Steamed = factor(
      Steamed,
      levels = cat_order
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Define transition labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

trans_counts <- trans_counts %>%
  mutate(
    Transition = paste(
      `Non-Steamed`,
      "\u2192",
      Steamed
    )
  )

trans_counts <- trans_counts %>%
  mutate(
    `Non-Steamed` = recode(
      `Non-Steamed`,
      "Not classified" = "NC",
      "Rhizosphere specialist" = "RS",
      "Progressive colonizer" = "PC",
      "Spermosphere specialist" = "SS"
    ),
    Steamed = recode(
      Steamed,
      "Not classified" = "NC",
      "Rhizosphere specialist" = "RS",
      "Progressive colonizer" = "PC",
      "Spermosphere specialist" = "SS"
    )
  )

trans_counts <- trans_counts %>%
  mutate(
    Transition = paste(`Non-Steamed`, "→", Steamed)
  )
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Custom colors
# ------------------------------------------------------------

transition_cols <- c(
  "NC → RS" = "#56B4E9",
  "NC → SS" = "#CC79A7",

  "RS → PC" = "#009E73",

  "PC → RS" = "#D55E00",

  "PC → NC" = "grey60",

  "RS → NC" = "grey40",

  "SS → NC" = "#8C510A",

  "SS → RS" = "#E69F00"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Alluvial plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

alluvial <- ggplot(
  trans_counts,
  aes(
    axis1 = `Non-Steamed`,
    axis2 = Steamed,
    y = n
  )
) +

  geom_alluvium(
    aes(fill = Transition),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_stratum(
    width = 0.25,
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
    size = 3
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
  values = transition_cols,
  name = NULL) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("Non-Steamed", "Steamed"),
    expand = c(.05, .05)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Bacilli OTUs"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
  legend.position = "right",
  legend.title = element_blank(),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
  legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
  legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm")
)

```

### Set up the analysis for the plant associated habitats
Importantly, we need to make sure the factor is ordered in the way that we want 
```{r}
# Subset to steamed spermosphere and rhizosphere samples only.
# filter_taxa() removes taxa with zero counts across all retained samples.
filt <- bac_sperm %>%
  subset_samples(Time %in% c("Planting", "17hrs", "V2") & Type != "Bulk.Soil" & Trt == "Non.Steamed") %>%
  microbiome::core_members(
    detection = 5,
    prevalence = 0.50
  )

filtered_bac <- bac_sperm %>%
  subset_samples(Time %in% c("Planting", "17hrs", "V2") & Type != "Bulk.Soil" & Trt == "Non.Steamed") %>%
  prune_taxa(filt, .)

data.frame(sample_data(filtered_bac))

meta_df <- data.frame(sample_data(filtered_bac)) %>%
  mutate(
    Time = factor(
      Time,
      levels = c(
        "Planting",
        "17hrs",
        "V2"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

# Verify factor ordering.
levels(meta_df$Time)
```

#### Run maaslin3 on the ordered factor for steamed and non-steamed soil
```{r}
# steamed
filt_counts <- as.data.frame(
  t(as(otu_table(filtered_bac), "matrix"))
)

fit <- maaslin3(
  input_data = filt_counts,
  input_metadata = meta_df,
  output = "maaslin3_NonSteamed_time",
  formula = "~ Time",
  augment = TRUE,
  standardize = TRUE,
  max_significance = 0.1,
  median_comparison_abundance = FALSE,
  median_comparison_prevalence = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
        "Decreased from planting into rhizosphere",
      name == "Time.Q" &
        coef > 0 ~
        "Peaked in spermosphere",
      name == "Time.Q" &

    Trt = "Steamed"
  )
```

```{r}
run_deseq <- function(ps){

  sample_data(ps)$Time <-
    factor(
      sample_data(ps)$Time,
      levels = c("Planting","17hrs")
    )

  dds <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(
    ps,
    ~ Time
  )

  dds <- DESeq(
    dds,
    fitType = "parametric"
  )

  res <- results(
    dds,
    contrast = c(
      "Time",
      "17hrs",
      "Planting"
    )
  )

  res <- as.data.frame(res)

  res$taxon <- rownames(res)

  res
}


```

#DESEQ2 Differential Abundance Analysis Pre-Filtering
```{r}
bac_sperm_filt <- core(bac_sperm, detection = 5, prevalence = .1)

DETimeSpermSteam <- bac_sperm_filt %>%
    subset_samples(Trt == "Steamed " & Type == "Spermosphere" & Time %in% c("Planting","17hrs"))

DETimeSpermNonsteam <- bac_sperm_filt %>%
    subset_samples(Trt == "Non.Steamed" & Type == "Spermosphere" & Time %in% c("Planting","17hrs"))

DETimeSoilSteam <- bac_sperm_filt %>%
    subset_samples(Trt == "Steamed " & Type == "Bulk.Soil" & Time %in% c("Planting","17hrs"))

DETimeSoilNonsteam <- bac_sperm_filt %>%
    subset_samples(Trt == "Non.Steamed" & Type == "Bulk.Soil" & Time %in% c("Planting","17hrs"))

Soybean_Epiphyte.present <- bac_sperm_filt %>%
    subset_samples(Trt == "Soybean Epiphytes") %>%
    core(detection = 5, prevalence = .1) %>%
    psmelt() %>% #combining the Physeq Objec
    group_by(OTU, Trt, Time, Type) %>% #Grouping by different 
    dplyr::summarize(sumabund = sum(Abundance)) #Has Zeros in It? (dpylr :: makes it use the command from that)

Soybean_Epiphyte.present <- as.character(Soybean_Epiphyte.present$OTU)
```

#DESEQ2 Differential Abundance Analysis for Steamed Spermosphere Samples
```{r}
diagdds = phyloseq_to_deseq2(DETimeSpermSteam, ~Time)

diagdds = DESeq(diagdds, test="Wald", fitType="parametric")
res = results(diagdds, cooksCutoff = FALSE)
alpha = 1
sigtab = res[which(res$padj < alpha), ]
sigtab = cbind(as(sigtab, "data.frame"), as(tax_table(DETimeSpermSteam)[rownames(sigtab), ], "matrix"))

sigtab1 <- sigtab %>%
  mutate(diff_abund = ifelse(padj < 0.01, TRUE, FALSE))

SpermSteamPlot <- ggplot(sigtab1, aes(x = -log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = diff_abund)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = padj <= 0.01)) +
  geom_text_repel(data = sigtab1[sigtab1$padj <= 0.01,],
                  aes(label = Genus), size = 6) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Differential Abundance with DESeq2") +
  #scale_color_manual(values = c(cbbPalette, ibm.cbb, tol.cbb), name = "Phylum") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cbbPalette, name  = "Significance") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(20,24), name = "p <= 0.05")
SpermSteamPlot

```

#microeco
```{r}
library(microeco)
library(file2meco)
bac_sperm_filt@sam_data$TrtType <- paste(bac_sperm_filt@sam_data$Type, bac_sperm_filt@sam_data$Trt, sep = "_")
bac_sperm_filt@sam_data$TrtTypeTime <- paste(bac_sperm_filt@sam_data$TrtType, bac_sperm_filt@sam_data$Time, sep = "_")

 microeco_bac_sperm <- phyloseq2meco(bac_sperm_filt) 

 test <- clone(microeco_bac_sperm)

test$cal_betadiv()
test$cal_alphadiv()

# generate trans_nullmodel object
# as an example, we only use high abundance OTU with mean relative abundance > 0.0005
t1 <- trans_nullmodel$new(test, filter_thres = 0.0005, add_data = bac_sperm_filt@sam_data)

str(t1)

t1$cal_mantel_corr(use_env = "TrtTypeTime")
t1$plot_mantel_corr()

# see null.model parameter for other null models
# null model run 500 times for the example
t1$cal_ses_betampd(runs = 500, abundance.weighted = TRUE)
# return t1$res_ses_betampd
# add betaNRI matrix to beta_diversity list
test$beta_diversity[["betaNRI"]] <- t1$res_ses_betampd
# create trans_beta class, use measure "betaNRI"
t2 <- trans_beta$new(dataset = test, group = "TrtTypeTime", measure = "betaNRI")
# transform the distance for each group
t2$cal_group_distance()
# see the help document for more methods, e.g. "anova" and "KW_dunn"
library(agricolae)
t2$cal_group_distance_diff(method = "anova")

# plot the results
g1 <- t2$plot_group_distance(add = "mean")
g1 + geom_hline(yintercept = -2, linetype = 2) + geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = 2)


library(tidyverse)

Resgroup <- t2$res_group_distance

Resgroup2 <- Resgroup %>%
  separate(TrtTypeTime, into = c("Type", "Trt", "Time"), sep = "_") %>%
  subset(Type != "Bulk.Soil")
  
Resgroup2$Time<- factor(Resgroup2$Time, levels = c("Planting", "17hrs", "V2"))

 BetaNRIplot <- Resgroup2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Value, color = Trt)) +
  #facet_wrap(~factor(Time, levels = c("Planting", "17hrs", "V2")), scale = "free") +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge2(0.85, preserve = "single")) + 
  geom_point(position=position_jitterdodge(0.05)) +
  #geom_pwc(aes(group = Trt), method = "t_test", label = "p.adj.format") +
  #stat_compare_means(method = "t.test") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-4, 4), breaks = seq(-4, 4), 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cbbPalette ) +
  color_palette(cbbPalette) +
  #stat_summary(fun = mean,geom="line") +
  #stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.5) +
  ylab("betaNRI") +
  xlab("Type of Environment")+
  #geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.8)+
  #scale_color_manual(values=cbbPalette, name = "", labels = c("Planting", "17hrs", "V2")) +  
  #stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal", hide.ns = TRUE) +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 12), legend.title = element_blank())
 
sessionInfo() 

BetaNRIplot <- Resgroup2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Value, color = Trt)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge2(0.85, preserve = "single")) + 
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(0.05)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -2, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-4, 4), breaks = seq(-4, 4, 0.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cbbPalette) +
  color_palette(cbbPalette) +
  ylab("betaNRI") +
  xlab("Type of Environment") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 12), legend.title = element_blank())


                
# null model run 500 times
t1$cal_ses_betamntd(runs = 500, abundance.weighted = TRUE, null.model = "taxa.labels")
# return t1$res_ses_betamntd

# result stored in t1$res_rcbray
t1$cal_rcbray(runs = 1000)
# return t1$res_rcbray

# use betaNTI and rcbray to evaluate processes
t1$cal_process(use_betamntd = TRUE, group = "TrtTypeTime")
TRTYPETIME <- t1$res_process
t1$cal_process(use_betamntd = TRUE, group = "TrtType")
TRTYPE <- t1$res_process

t1$cal_process(use_betamntd = TRUE)

# require NST package to be installed
install.packages("NST")
library(NST)

t1$cal_NST(method = "tNST", group = "TrtTypeTime", dist.method = "bray", abundance.weighted = TRUE, output.rand = TRUE, SES = TRUE)
t1$res_NST$index.grp

# test the NST difference between each pair of groups
t1$cal_NST_test(method = "nst.boot")

# convert long format table to square matrix
# the 10th column: MST.ij.bray in t1$res_NST$index.pair
test <- t1$cal_NST_convert(10)

# for pNST method, phylogenetic tree is needed
t1$cal_NST(method = "pNST", group = "Group", output.rand = TRUE, SES = TRUE)
t1$cal_NST_test(method = "nst.boot")

str(t1)

t1$cal_NRI(null.model = "taxa.labels", abundance.weighted = FALSE, runs = 999)
t1$cal_NTI(null.model = "taxa.labels", abundance.weighted = TRUE, runs = 999)
```

```{r}
b <- bac_sperm %>%

  group_by(OTU, Trt, Time, Type) %>% #Grouping by different
```

### diff abundance test ###
```{r}

diff.abund <- readRDS("SteamedDiffAbund_Bac.rds") ##Using Non-normalized Reads

diff.abund <- diff.abund$res
diff.abund2 <- left_join(diff.abund, tax.bac, by = c("taxon" = "OTU"))
diff.abund2$diff_abund <- interaction(diff.abund2$diff_hoursafterplanting2B, diff.abund2$diff_hoursafterplanting2V2)
diff.abund2$time_diff_abund <- ifelse(diff.abund2$diff_abund == "TRUE.TRUE", "Difference Across Both Times", 
                                      ifelse(diff.abund2$diff_abund == "TRUE.FALSE", "Spermosphere Only",
                                             ifelse(diff.abund2$diff_abund == "FALSE.TRUE", "Rhizosphere Only",
                                               ifelse(diff.abund2$diff_abund == "FALSE.FALSE", "No Difference", 
                                                    "Not Different"))))
view(diff.abund2)
##BELOW IS OLD CODE
diff.abund2$Crop_diff_abund <- ifelse(diff.abund2$diff_abund == "TRUE.TRUE.TRUE", "Difference Across All Times", 
                                      ifelse(diff.abund2$diff_abund == "TRUE.TRUE.FALSE", "Spermosphere Only",
                                             ifelse(diff.abund2$diff_abund == "TRUE.FALSE.FALSE", "Planting Only",
                                                    ifelse(diff.abund2$diff_abund == "FALSE.FALSE.FALSE", "No Difference Across All Times",
                                                           ifelse(diff.abund2$diff_abund == "FALSE.FALSE.TRUE", "Rhizosphere Only",
                                                                  ifelse(diff.abund2$diff_abund == "FALSE.TRUE.FALSE", "17 Hours Only",
                                                                         ifelse(diff.abund2$diff_abund == "FALSE.TRUE.TRUE", "17 Hours and Rhizosphere Only",
                                                                                ifelse(diff.abund2$diff_abund == "TRUE.FALSE.TRUE", "Planting and Rhizosphere Only", "Not Different"))))))))

saveRDS(diff.abund2, "SteamedDiffAbund2.rds")
diff.abund2 <- readRDS("SteamedDiffAbund2.rds")
```

```{r}
  mutate(freq = round(n / sum(n), 2))
```

##NONSTEAMED##
```{r}
b$PA <- ifelse(b$sumabund > 0, 1, 0)
Soybean_Epiphyte.present <- b$OTU[b$PA == 1 & b$Trt == "Soybean Epiphytes"]
BulkSoil_Planting_NonSteamed.present <- b$OTU[b$PA == 1 & b$Trt == "Non.Steamed" & b$Time == "Planting" & b$Type == "Bulk.Soil"]
nb1 <- intersect(Soybean_Epiphyte.present, BulkSoil_Planting_NonSteamed.present)

nc <- bac_sperm %>%
      subset_taxa(OTU %in% nb1) %>%
      subset_samples(Type %in% c("Spermosphere", "Rhizosphere") & Trt %in% "Non.Steamed") %>%
      subset_samples(Time != "Planting") %>%
      phyloseq::filter_taxa(function(x) sum(x) > 0, TRUE)
#### taxonomy table ####
ntax.bac <- nc %>%
  tax_table() %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
###Tranmission PA/Microbial Dynamic Analysis
b1 <- bac_sperm %>%
  phyloseq_filter_prevalence(prev.trh = 0.1, abund.trh = NULL, threshold_condition = "OR",abund.type = "total") %>%
  psmelt() %>% #combining the Physeq Object

  dplyr::summarize(sumabund = sum(Abundance)) #Has Zeros in It? #Make sure the package dplyr is loaded last or specifiy it

#remotes::install_github("vmikk/metagMisc")

BulkSoil_Planting_Steamed.present <- b1$OTU[b1$PA == 1 & b1$Time == "Planting" & b1$Type == "Bulk.Soil"]

    subset(taxon %in% Soybean_Epiphyte.present)

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 12)) +
```
